first.rationale: Prioritize verification of onboarding simplification because the current onboarding-completion decline makes it highly consequential to sustainable qualified revenue, and verify promotional pricing because competitor entry pricing creates a material alternative explanation and response path for SMB losses. Pending confirmation, run an onboarding-simplification experiment aimed at restoring completion and time-to-value; measure downstream qualified activation and revenue rather than completion alone to guard against lower-intent or lower-quality progression.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and demonstrated improved completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and a 3% lift in 30-day retention—evidence aligned with sustainable qualified revenue rather than a superficial funnel metric. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue initially, verification showed a 12% 30-day retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle. Evaluate the onboarding variant on meaningful activation, qualified revenue, and retention, not completion alone.
